foundation.note_en: Lead: phase 1, 120 MW = 34 × 3 MW + 3 × 6 MW (Guangdong key-project record); the first 34 stand on inserted four-pile jackets, all completed; the “phase-1 follow-up and phase 2” (101.15 MW, 15 units in phase 2) was built by CCCC Third Harbour from Nov 2020, with four monopiles driven in the first ten days; the whole 198 MW was fully connected in Dec 2021.
